_channel_note: Family Learning Channel — fun educational songs and rhymes that parents teach their kids together.
_voice_note: Custom kids voice (5ECyMHB4NuUFCq2YxatW). Falls back to Google Cloud TTS Aoede (warm female Chirp3-HD voice).
_visual_prompt_mode_note: kids_rhyming = H3 native voice + 3D animation style (no TTS, bright cheerful visuals). cinematic = action/fight scene style. narration = TTS voice (ElevenLabs Gigi) muxed with H3 cinematic b-roll.
_script_duration_note: Kids videos are shorter — 1-2 minutes. At 150 WPM: 1 min = ~150 words, 2 min = ~300 words.
_script_style_note: Writing style: educational produces engaging, parent-friendly learning content about colors, numbers, animals, etc.
_weekly_schedule_note: Kids content performs best in the morning. Schedule at 8 AM IST (2:30 UTC).

instagram_reels._facebook_page_id_note: RhymeVhyme Facebook Page ID — enables automatic Reel mirroring to Facebook Page.
